what: Coordinator's finding, relayed by speed (lane codegen isn't done, so speed doesn't edit it): blaze-codegen has about 10 to 13 clone()s and Vec::new()s per 1000 lines. Audit every clone/to_owned/to_vec/to_string/collect-into-new-Vec/Vec::new/Box::new/Arc::new/format! in crates/blaze-codegen. For each one on a hot path (per function compiled, per relocation, per fragment, per cache lookup or hit), use a per-task arena (blaze-mem), a buffer reused across calls, u32 ids instead of cloned values, or a borrow instead of a clone made for the borrow checker. Mark the cold ones (error, setup, once per process) that hot_lint flags with `// alloc:` / `// clone:`. Add allocation-budget tests with blaze-alloc-count: zero per warm cache hit and per relocation. Why: principles.md 'Fast code, line by line' and the 10% bar; a cache hit must allocate nothing. Same audit is running for blaze-core and blaze-graph (speed-core-clones).

history.note: blaze-codegen alloc audit: fold.rs counting sort onto radix::Csr, memo.rs a_lookup_allocates_nothing and relocs.rs reading_relocations_allocates_nothing budget tests, cold allocations and copies marked alloc:/clone:, hot_lint clean in my files (findings left in sibling exec.rs and flight.rs for codegen-names and codegen-later)
